alice: Heads-up — scheduling tenant-index online swap + controlled backfill in the 00:30 UTC change window. We'll pin service to v2.3.3 for the duration to avoid mismatch. Need clear abort criteria and an escape hatch.
ben: Quick Q: expected exclusive lock time on swap?
sasha: Swap is quick (~100-400ms). Backfill touches ~12M rows across shards. Plan: micro-batches, dynamic throttle. Abort triggers: lock_wait >20s on any primary for 2 shards within 5m OR deadlock_count >=1 in 10m OR write_error_rate >1% sustained 5m.
deploybot: Migration job created (alice) at 2026-04-01T00:10:01Z. ID: mig-20260401-tnidx-03. Config: batch=100, stagger=150, rate_limit=800r/s. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/migs/tnidx-03
```bash
./deploybot start-migration --id mig-20260401-tnidx-03 --batch 100 --stagger 150 --rate 800
```
mike: Recommend a pre-window canary drain (route 10% to canary for 8m) to surface tail latencies. infra-bot: scheduled at 00:22 UTC.
tim: Oncall standby. Add emergency abort to pager: `/deploybot abort-migration mig-20260401-tnidx-03 --reason "lock-pressure"` and verify phone oncall.
alice: Release note updated: "Tenant-index online swap + controlled backfill (v2.3.3 pinned) — rate-limited; brief latency blips possible." Pin applied.
sasha: I'll monitor metrics and post live updates. Will call abort if triggers hit.
deploybot: Job mig-20260401-tnidx-03 scheduled for 2026-04-01T00:30:00Z. If aborted, deploybot will pause batches, roll back the swap if in-flight, and mark job aborted in CI. Keep runbook open.
